tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: What IoMarkets.ai is and what is built: the Data API (verifiable market data AI agents pay for per call over x402) and Federated Computing (private computing across organisations on confidential hardware), with the main pages and what is a demonstration.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Step-by-step instructions, with the exact button names, for one task on iomarkets.ai. Without a task, lists the tasks.

tools.name: explain_term
tools.description: A plain-English meaning of a word used on the site: x402, USDC, Algorand, test network, signed proof, Federated Computing, confidential hardware, attestation, receipt, AI agent, MCP. Without a word, lists them all.

tools.name: list_data_endpoints
tools.description: The Data API catalogue: each endpoint, what it returns, its parameters and its indicative price per call in USDC, plus how payment works and the indicative plans.

tools.name: get_api_status
tools.description: Whether the Data API at api.iomarkets.ai is up right now.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Every Federated Computing run done on confidential hardware, newest first: its id, what it showed and the hardware it ran on.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: One Federated Computing run in detail: what it showed, the model and data, hardware, location, result, payment, and whether its receipt verifies (checked now, with the same code as the receipt checker).

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: What Federated Computing runs cost in confidential cloud time, at Google Cloud list prices, for the machines and run times the real runs used, plus key services. Same numbers as the cost estimator page. An estimate, not a quote.

tools.name: draft_evaluation_request
tools.description: Turn what someone wants to evaluate, in their own words, into a Federated Computing evaluation request. Returns the message and a link that opens it in their email app; nothing is sent for them, and they can also use the form. Ask for anything missing, one question at a time, before calling it.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "draft_evaluation_request" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Turn what someone wants to evaluate, in their own words, into a Federated Computing evaluation request. Returns the message and a link that opens it in their em…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
